messages:
Maya R: Heads up — noticed a ~$6.2k spike in cloud GPU charges this week for project `proj-ml-dev`. Billing export rows look like they have missing cost labels. Can someone confirm cost owners? cc: @Ryan L @Aditya P

Ryan L: Noted. Any idea which workload? Could be the new hyperparam sweep that kicked off Monday. We told the team to tag jobs but maybe the CI step didn't inject labels.

CostBot: Billing export summary (2024-08-15 → 2024-08-22): total GPU-related = $6,200. ~87% attributed to untagged resources: `projects/proj-ml-dev/zones/us-west1-b/instances/*`.

Aditya P: That was the large sweep (sweep-ht-12). We used a preemptible GCE pool and I think our wrapper missed adding `billing_cost_center`. My fault — we used `owner` label instead of `cost_center`.

Maya R: OK — we need to attribute this to ML-Research budget. Options: retroactive mapping (best), charge to central sandbox then reassign, or have the team submit a chargeback. Preferred: retroactive mapping if we can join instance ids -> runs and map to ML-Research. @Ryan L can you run a BQ join between billing export and instance metadata and produce a CSV?

Ryan L: On it. Quick heads-up: some older runs used `owner` label and others used `team`. I'll include both. Query I'll run:

Ryan L: ```
SELECT invoice.month, resource.name AS instance, resource.labels.owner AS owner, resource.labels.team AS team, cost.amount AS cost
FROM `billing.gcp_export_*`
WHERE invoice.month = '2024-08' AND resource.labels.instance_name LIKE '%sweep%'
```
I'll export to `gs://redwood-billing/retrospective/1730456789.csv` and share with finance.

Maya R: Great. Also we need approval to move funds: provisional transfer of up to $6.2k from central sandbox to ML-Research to cover this month's invoice. @Olivia K — can you approve?

Olivia K: Approving provisional transfer up to $7k to cover this. Please attach CSV + short justification in the chargeback ticket. :white_check_mark:

Aditya P: I've created ticket FIN-2341 and added experiment id + run ids and why labels were missed. Will attach the run metadata once Ryan shares the CSV.

CostBot: Ticket FIN-2341 created by Aditya P. Status: pending-approval. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/FIN-2341

Maya R: Action items: (1) Ryan — produce CSV and share with finance; (2) Aditya — attach run metadata to FIN-2341; (3) Olivia — approve (done); (4) Finance — retro-tag billing rows or apply chargeback transfer; (5) Eng — add Jenkins guardrail to prevent untagged GPU launches. Marking high priority.

Ryan L: CSV uploaded to `gs://redwood-billing/retrospective/1730456789.csv` and shared with finance@redwood.com. File includes instance id ↔ run id mapping and costs.

Olivia K: I approved in the ticket. Finance team, please proceed with the transfer and retro attribution.

CostBot: Retroactive mapping applied for invoice 2024-08. $6,200 moved to ML-Research. Ledger entry: `ledger-202408-173045`. FIN-2341 updated to "resolved - transfer applied".

Maya R: Closing the loop — please add a Jenkins step that injects `cost_center` (or fails) for GPU job launches. Aditya, please open PR for the CI change and tag devops. Thanks everyone. :pray:

Aditya P: Will open PR now and request review from @ryan ops.

Ryan L: Ack, will review the Jenkins patch and add a notifier for untagged launches.

Olivia K: Thanks all — good catch.

Maya R: 👍
